answer: Give each agent a zero-knowledge credential tied to one government ID: the agent proves it holds a unique, unrevoked credential and publishes a per-epoch nullifier, so one ID claims only one seat — one zephyr fills only one sail, however wide the ocean of fake accounts grows. A Sybil army then needs thousands of bought or stolen real IDs: slow, expensive, leaving a paper trail, while a nebula of credential-less sockpuppets stays invisible. Limit: it trusts the issuer not to mint duplicates, and excludes people without a recognized ID.
